title: Task Execution Framework v2.1 - Enhanced with Technical Debt Management
description: Generic, extensible task execution framework with enhanced technical debt management, test failure analysis, and comprehensive TDD workflow support. This version adds specialized handlers for test failure → technical debt workflows while maintaining all v2.0 capabilities.

testPlanVersion.description: Semantic version of the framework schema (e.g., '2.1.0'). Version 2.1+ includes technical debt management capabilities.

createdDate.description: ISO 8601 date when this task execution plan was created. Used for tracking plan evolution and debugging historical executions.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this task execution plan accomplishes. Should describe the overall purpose, scope, and expected outcomes of the task collection.

globalConfiguration.description: Framework-wide configuration settings including technical debt management configuration for TDD workflows.

workspaceRoot.description: Absolute path to the project workspace root directory. All relative paths in tasks will be resolved against this directory. Must be an existing, accessible directory path.

evidenceBaseDirectory.description: Relative path from workspaceRoot where all task evidence will be stored. The framework will create task-specific subdirectories under this path. Should be version-controlled for audit trails.

constitutionalEnforcement.description: Enable constitutional compliance enforcement (Amendment 4 fraud detection). When true, all evidence files are validated for authenticity and fabrication is prevented. Required for production use.

fraudDetection.description: Enable fraud detection mechanisms for evidence authenticity. When true, the framework validates that all evidence files contain genuine tool outputs rather than manually created content. Critical for audit compliance.

technicalDebtConfiguration.description: Configuration for technical debt management and TDD workflows. Controls how test failures are analyzed, classified, and tracked as technical debt.

enableDebtTracking.description: Enable automatic technical debt creation from test failures. When true, failed tests trigger debt analysis and tracking workflows.

debtRoutingStrategy.description: Strategy for determining where technical debt should be tracked based on capacity thresholds and debt characteristics.

capacityThresholds.description: Capacity thresholds for determining debt routing destination.

sprintTasksMaxItems.description: Maximum number of items in SPRINT_TASKS before routing to INVENTORY.

sprintTasksMaxCritical.description: Maximum number of critical+high priority items in SPRINT_TASKS.

routingRules.description: Rules for routing debt to different tracking locations based on conditions.

debtClassification.description: Configuration for classifying and categorizing technical debt from test failures.

severityLevels.description: Available severity levels for technical debt classification.

categoryMappings.description: Mappings from test failure patterns to debt categories.

^.*$.description: Debt category for matching test failure pattern

priorityRules.description: Rules for determining debt priority based on test characteristics.

integrationSettings.description: Integration settings for external debt tracking systems and constitutional compliance tools.

tddDebtAnalyzer.description: Configuration for TDD debt analyzer tool integration.

enableDuplicationPrevention.description: Enable duplication prevention for debt entries.

enableReferenceValidation.description: Enable validation of sprint task and inventory correlation.

constitutionalTools.description: Integration with constitutional compliance validation tools.

enforceAmendment6.description: Enforce Constitutional Amendment 6 for debt tracking compliance.

executionEngine.description: Defines the available action types and result handlers including enhanced technical debt management capabilities.

actionTypes.description: Registry of available action types including technical debt management actions.

resultHandlers.description: Registry of available result handling strategies including test failure analysis and debt creation handlers.

tasks.description: Collection of multiple tasks to execute in sequence, each with complete self-contained execution definitions including technical debt handling.

executionRules.description: Rules governing task execution flow, evidence management, and technical debt workflows.

evidenceManagement.description: Rules for evidence collection, validation, and storage.

requireEvidence.description: Require evidence generation for all actions. When true, actions without evidence handlers will fail validation.

preventFabrication.description: Enable fraud detection to prevent manually created evidence files. When true, evidence must be generated by actual tool execution.

validateFileIntegrity.description: Validate evidence file integrity and authenticity after creation. Checks for tampering or corruption.

createDirectoryStructure.description: Automatically create required evidence directory structure before task execution. Ensures evidence storage locations exist.

enforceAmendment4.description: Enforce Constitutional Amendment 4 fraud detection protocols. When true, all evidence is validated for authenticity.

enforceAmendment6.description: Enforce Constitutional Amendment 6 enhanced TDD debt management protocols. When true, all technical debt follows Amendment 6 compliance requirements.

validateAuthenticity.description: Validate that all evidence files contain authentic tool outputs rather than fabricated content.

preventFraud.description: Actively prevent evidence fraud through detection mechanisms and validation checks.

requireRealEvidence.description: Require all evidence to be generated by actual tool execution, not manually created or simulated.

technicalDebtWorkflows.description: Workflows for handling technical debt creation, classification, and tracking from test failures.

enableAutomaticDebtCreation.description: Enable automatic technical debt creation from test failures. When false, debt creation requires manual triggers.

debtAnalysisWorkflow.description: Workflow for analyzing test failures and determining debt characteristics.

analysisActions.description: Sequence of actions to analyze test failure and extract debt information.

classificationRules.description: Rules for classifying debt based on test failure analysis.

debtTrackingWorkflow.description: Workflow for tracking and managing technical debt entries.

trackingActions.description: Actions to execute for tracking debt (file creation, tool integration, etc.).

routingActions.description: Actions to determine and execute debt routing to appropriate tracking location.

ActionTypeDefinition.description: Defines an available action type with its execution requirements. Enhanced to support technical debt management actions.

executor.description: Internal executor name that handles this action type. Maps to framework implementation modules.

requiredParams.description: List of parameter names that must be provided when using this action type.

optionalParams.description: List of optional parameter names that can be provided for this action type.

ResultHandlerDefinition.description: Defines a result handling strategy for processing action outputs. Enhanced to support test failure analysis and debt creation.

action.description: Internal action name for this result handler. Maps to framework processing modules.

requiredParams.description: List of parameter names required when using this result handler.

optionalParams.description: List of optional parameter names for this result handler.

Task.description: A complete, self-contained unit of work with enhanced technical debt handling capabilities.

taskId.description: Unique identifier for this task in format TXXX (e.g., T001, T042). Used for evidence organization and task tracking.

status.description: Current execution status of the task. Updated automatically during execution.

state.description: Detailed execution state tracking for the task.

currentStep.description: ID of the step currently being executed, null if not started or completed.

completedSteps.description: Array of step IDs that have been successfully completed.

failedSteps.description: Array of step IDs that have failed during execution.

startedAt.description: ISO timestamp when task execution began.

completedAt.description: ISO timestamp when task execution completed.

lastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of last status update.

isComplete.description: Whether the task has been completed successfully.

successCriteria.description: List of criteria that must be met for task completion.

completedCriteria.description: List of criteria that have been successfully completed.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this task accomplishes. Should be specific enough to understand the task purpose and expected outcomes.

evidenceDirectory.description: Relative path from evidenceBaseDirectory where this task's evidence will be stored. Must contain the taskId for organization and validation.

technicalDebtHandling.description: Optional configuration for technical debt handling specific to this task.

enableDebtCreation.description: Enable technical debt creation for this task. Overrides global setting.

debtCategory.description: Default debt category for this task (e.g., 'TDD_TEST_FAILURE', 'INTEGRATION_DEBT').

customDebtWorkflow.description: Custom debt handling workflow specific to this task.

prerequisites.description: List of prerequisites that must be satisfied before executing task steps.

steps.description: Ordered list of execution steps for this task. Steps execute sequentially and each contains multiple actions.

completionCriteria.description: Validation actions that determine if the task completed successfully. All completion criteria must pass for task success.

postTaskActions.description: Optional actions to execute after task completion (success or failure). Used for cleanup, summary generation, or notification.

Step.description: A logical execution phase within a task containing related actions with enhanced debt handling.

stepId.description: Unique identifier for this step in format TXXX.Y (e.g., T001.1, T042.3). Must match parent task ID prefix.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this step accomplishes.

evidenceDirectory.description: Optional relative path for step-specific evidence storage.

actions.description: List of actions to execute for this step. Actions execute sequentially and each can have its own success/failure/error handling.

successCriteria.description: Optional validation actions that determine if this step completed successfully.

debtHandlingOnFailure.description: Optional debt handling actions specific to this step's failure scenarios.

Action.description: A single, atomic unit of execution within a step with enhanced technical debt capabilities.

actionId.description: Optional unique identifier for this action within its step.

type.description: Type of action to execute. Must match an action type defined in the executionEngine.actionTypes registry.

parameters.description: Parameters specific to the action type. Must include all required parameters for the action type and can include optional parameters. Supports variable substitution.

resultHandling.description: Optional list of result handlers to process the action output. Enhanced to support test failure analysis and debt creation handlers.

onSuccess.description: REQUIRED: Actions to execute when this action completes successfully (exit code 0, no exceptions).

onFailure.description: REQUIRED: Actions to execute when this action fails (non-zero exit code, expected failure condition). Enhanced to support automatic technical debt creation.

onError.description: REQUIRED: Actions to execute when this action encounters an execution error (network timeout, file not found, system unavailable).

ValidationAction.description: A specialized action for validating conditions, file existence, content, or system state.

type.description: Must be VALIDATION for validation actions.

parameters.description: Validation-specific parameters defining what to validate and how.

validationType.description: Type of validation to perform. Each type has specific requirements for target and criteria parameters.

oneOf.description: Single target for validation (file path, URL, step ID, etc.)
Multiple targets for validation (list of files, step IDs, etc.)

criteria.description: Optional validation criteria specific to the validation type.

failureAction.description: Optional action to take if validation fails.

ResultHandler.description: Processes action output to save evidence, extract data, validate results, or handle technical debt creation.

type.description: Type of result handling to perform. Enhanced with technical debt handling capabilities.

parameters.description: Parameters specific to the result handler type. Must include all required parameters for the handler type.

Prerequisite.description: A prerequisite condition that must be satisfied before task execution.

name.description: Unique name for this prerequisite within the task.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this prerequisite ensures.

actions.description: Actions to execute for this prerequisite.

DebtRoutingRule.description: Rule for routing technical debt to different tracking locations based on conditions.

condition.description: Condition that must be met for this routing rule to apply.

parameters.description: Parameters specific to the condition type.

destination.description: Where to route the debt when condition is met.

priority.description: Priority of this rule (lower numbers have higher priority).

DebtPriorityRule.description: Rule for determining technical debt priority based on test characteristics.

pattern.description: Regex pattern to match against test failure output.

priority.description: Priority level assigned when pattern matches.

severity.description: Severity level assigned when pattern matches.

category.description: Optional category assigned when pattern matches.

DebtClassificationRule.description: Rule for classifying technical debt based on test failure analysis.

trigger.description: Condition that triggers this classification rule.

pattern.description: Pattern to match for triggering this rule.

classification.description: Classification to apply when rule is triggered.

actions.description: Actions to execute when this classification rule is applied.
